references.reader: Claude Opus 5.5 (reviewer_kind assistant) on contact sheets (<= 1280 px; the framed crop in the native frame's context); no human checked them
references.r1: every line, once: candidates are the distinct plausible readings (eval/clannad_refs.plausible: at most half ASCII letters or digits) of the two local labelling engines on the same crop (MeikiOCR's recognizer, PP-OCRv6 small; teacher/engines, pinned files, offline), never Lens or any compared arm; pick, type the text, unsure, or skip (notext / multi / cut / ui / bad)
references.r2: every line, an independent second read in other sessions: candidates are the distinct plausible readings of R1's decision, both engines, Lens and every arm, shuffled per line and unattributed (no counts, no sources); same choices
references.r3: every line where R1 and R2 do not give the same agreement key (teacher/vote.key, eval's scoring normalisation): a third read, candidates as in R2 plus R2's decision, shuffled again
references.rule: the reference is the text that at least two of the reads give (same key); a line two reads skip or mark unsure, or where no two reads agree, is excluded for every arm and counted
references.flags: every scored line whose reference key differs from Lens's reading is flagged lens-disagree (counts public, the lines private)
references.conventions: eval's labelling conventions: the framed text only, left to right; never furigana, cursor icons or button glyphs; full-width ！？～, … per cell of dots, ― for a long dash
references.frozen: refs.jsonl is hashed into refs.freeze.json before any score is computed; arm predictions are produced before R2 (as R2's unattributed candidates) but no score is computed until the freeze
references.skips: notext: no text in the frame (scene art, box edges, a cursor); multi: more than one text line inside the frame; cut: the frame cuts through a character; ui: menus and system text; bad: anything else that is not one readable horizontal line

metrics.normalisation: eval/metrics.norm (NFKC, whitespace removed, ellipses / dashes / tildes folded; small kana, dakuten, ー/一 and lookalike kanji distinct)
metrics.cer: sum of Levenshtein distances / sum of reference characters over the scored lines
metrics.exact: share of scored lines whose normalised prediction equals the normalised reference
metrics.intervals: 95% percentile intervals from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of whole screens (pages; numpy default_rng(0), sorted page ids); one title, so no VN clusters
metrics.pairs: CAND - BASE in points with the paired page bootstrap (eval/vocr3_report.paired_bootstrap for CER; the same resamples for exact)
metrics.secondary: each arm's edit disagreement with Lens on the same lines (the long run's proxy), for comparison with the published proxy numbers; never CER
metrics.notext: on the crops at least two reads skip as notext: per system, the lines with any output and the characters written (a finder false positive's cost, reported, never in CER)

public: counts, rates, intervals and hashes only (eval/vocr3_report.assert_public); references, readings, crops and sheets stay under shared/private/, never in git, never sent to Codex or any third party
one_attempt: score runs once on the frozen references; a failure is reported, not retried with changes
